name: @egress/rmq-consumer
description: The consumer SDK: an application declares its contracts, what it does with each message and the dependencies that work calls; this runs the rest — one breaker per dependency whose open state is a token in RabbitMQ's delay chain, the fleet's probe permits, the redrive of dead letters, a concurrency limit learned from throttled answers, parking and metrics. packages/consumer is the application written against it.
